summary: Scage Future (a Chinese manufacturer) filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to maintain a minimum $1.00 bid price over 30 consecutive business days (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company has until Dec 8, 2026 to regain compliance; no specific deal, acquisition, or restructuring is proposed. The filing also notes the resignation of independent director Calvin Kung due to unresolved operational disagreements. As this is an ordinary compliance disclosure, not a special-situation transaction, no further analysis applies.
